subject: Kickoff: GIFT - drift-resistant models for platform customers
body:
Hi Ivo,

Kicking off the GIFT workstream. Platform customers keep asking why their classifiers decay as their data drifts, and the honest answer today is "retrain and hope." Our open-source GIFT work gives us something better: when intermediate distributions exist, iterative self-training forms an implicit curriculum and walks the model to the target; when they do not, GIFT manufactures virtual intermediate samples by interpolating source and target representations. That is the wedge - gradual adaptation without asking customers for labeled intermediate data.

Milestones: repro the natural-shift benchmark results by 4/24, integrate with one internal pipeline as a pilot by 5/29, decision review by 6/17.

Katya leads research, Amara pipeline integration, Saoirse the serving-side hooks. Ivo, can I get staffing confirmation plus a compute sketch by end of next week?

Dmitri
